member.name: M:Emar.Api.Controllers.OrdersController.GetOrders(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Get a list of orders in the system.
member.param: *Optional.* \ eMAR unique patient identifier. If it is passed in then this API call will return all the orders for this patient.

*Optional.* \ Comma delimited list Order element to sort by: * **Id** * **Priority** * **OrderStatus** * **Begin** or **BeginDate** or **BeginTime** \ \ Optional **ASC** or **DESC** commands can be suffixed. \ *Default:* **Id ASC**
*Optional.* \ Comma delimited list of order elements to be returned. If omitted, all order elements are returned.
member.returns: An ActionResult of IEnumerable collection of type OrderDto

member.name: M:Emar.Api.Controllers.PatientsController.GetPatients(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.Nullable{System.Int16},System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Get a list of patients in the system.
member.param: *Optional.* \ Comma delimited list Patient element to sort by: * **Id** * **FullName** * **Age** * **DepartmentCode** * **WardCode** * **RoomBedCode** \ \ Optional **ASC** or **DESC** commands can be suffixed. \ *Default:* **Id ASC**
*Optional.* \ Comma delimited list of patient elements to be returned. If omitted, all patient elements are returned.
*Optional.* \ Site (facility) identifier to restrict the list of returned patients to.
*Optional.* \ Department code to restrict the list of returned patients to.
*Optional.* \ Comma delimited of ward (area) codes to restrict the list of returned patients to.
*Optional.* \ Room and bed code to restrict the list of returned patients to.
*Optional.* \ Include the inactive patients in the list of returned patients.
*Optional.* \ Include the patients orders in the list of returned patients.
*Optional.* \ First key of the external patient Id. In PulseCheck, it is the Site id.
*Optional.* \ Second key of the external patient Id. In PulseCheck, it is the Ibex number.
member.returns: An IActionResult of IEnumerable of type PatientDto
